atq.text: Gix begins as a human rebel of the Caves of the Damned who stabs Glacian with a powerstone shard, until Yawgmoth cures the resulting phthisis and coerces an oath of loyalty from him, pacifying his rebellion.
After Phyrexia's founding Gix is among the first compleated and becomes Yawgmoth's right-hand man in the Thran-Phyrexian War.

During the Brothers' War a demon enters Dominaria, takes over the monks' dreams and announces himself as Gix at Koilos, and he manipulates both brothers, fails to kill Mishra because of the Weakstone, and oversees Mishra's Compleation.
Gix lures both brothers to Argoth, where Urza's sylex blast wipes out both armies and forces Gix back to Phyrexia.

usg.text: Yawgmoth's wrath falls on Gix after the rift cuts Phyrexia off and he is cast into the Punishment Sphere, yet when Urza and Mishra take the powerstone and accidentally reopen the portal, Yawgmoth sends Gix to scout.
Gix manipulates both sides of the Brothers' War and compleates Mishra, and Urza realizes that Gix corrupted his brother, beginning his lifelong hunt for retribution.
At Koilos Gix gains the upper hand by negating the power in Urza's powerstones, but Xantcha and Ratepe reach into the beam and break his concentration, and their sacrifice lets Urza kill the praetor.
The Brotherhood of Gix later find their master's severed hand in Koilos.

tsb.text: Gix is remembered as the master of the Brotherhood of Gix, which dug out the cave of Koilos and found their master's severed hand and enshrined it.
